questions.question: Under the law God gave Moses, what happened to a newborn Israelite boy on the eighth day?

answers.text: He was named by the priest
He was brought to the altar

questions.question: In God's law for childbirth, a woman being purified after having a son could enter the sanctuary if she touched nothing sacred. True or false?
After her days of purification were complete, what did an Israelite mother bring the priest for her burnt offering?
If an Israelite mother could not afford a lamb for her offering, what did God say she could bring instead?

answers.text: Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
A tenth of an ephah of flour
A young goat from the flock
